public_basis.metaquotes_article: Price Action Analysis Toolkit Development (Part 38): Tick Buffer VWAP and Short-Window Imbalance Engine
public_basis.portability_note: Tick-count flow is a proxy for short-term directional pressure, not true exchange order-flow imbalance; uses bid/ask-derived midpoint changes and is reconstructible from MT5 tick history.

logic.price_stream: P75 synthetic midpoint derived causally from canonical bid/ask ticks
logic.flow: forward-chronology count of nonzero midpoint upticks vs downticks in trailing 30 seconds
logic.trigger: long when flow >= +0.30 and buy latch is clear; short when flow <= -0.30 and sell latch is clear
logic.hysteresis: buy latch rearms only after flow < +0.24; sell latch rearms only after flow > -0.24
logic.cadence: evaluate on completed 2-second UTC grid boundaries
logic.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after decision boundary
logic.note: No true DOM/order-size claim. This is a transparent tick-count directional-flow proxy.

selection_rule: advance the single published-default profile only if supply/economic gates pass; no threshold retuning after result
